31005-coquette.title: Coquette
31005-coquette.creator: Frank Swinnerton
31005-coquette.description: A book by Frank Swinnerton. In the flat above there was the sound of one who sang, vamping an accompaniment upon the piano and emphasising the simple time of his carol by a dully stamped foot upon the floor. His foot--making in soft slippers a dead "dump-dump-dump"--shook the ceiling of the Mintos' flat.

57101-mary-louise-at-dorfield.title: Mary Louise At Dorfield
57101-mary-louise-at-dorfield.creator: Edith Van Dyne
57101-mary-louise-at-dorfield.description: A book by Edith Van Dyne. The girls of Dorfield found it more difficult to settle down than anybody else. Fathers had always been busy, so had mothers. The returning soldiers had dropped into their old places and were at work almost as though there had been no amazing interlude of A. Only the girls seemed to be left out of the scheme of things. Many of them kept on working, although before the war the idea of making a living had been undreamed.

arxiv-1502-05191.title: Determining Training Needs for Cloud Infrastructure Investigations using I-STRIDE
arxiv-1502-05191.creator: Joshua I. James, Ahmed F. Shosha, Pavel Gladyhsev
arxiv-1502-05191.description: Abstract As more businesses and users adopt cloud computing services, security vulnerabilities will be increasingly found and exploited. There are many technological and political challenges where investigation of potentially criminal incidents in the cloud are concerned. Security experts, however, must still be able to acquire and analyze data in a methodical, rigorous and forensically sound manner.

arxiv-1808-00942.title: Maximal Flavour Violation: a Cabibbo mechanism for leptoquarks arXiv: 1808.00942
arxiv-1808-00942.creator: Luca Di Luzio, Javier Fuentes-Martin, Admir Greljo, Marco Nardecchia, Sophie Renner
arxiv-1808-00942.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Luca Di Luzio, Javier Fuentes-Martin, Admir Greljo, Marco Nardecchia, Sophie Renner. We propose a mechanism that allows for sizeable flavour violation in quark-lepton currents, while suppressing flavour changing neutral currents in quark-quark and lepton-lepton sectors.

arxiv-2201-00306.title: Unipotent Generators for Arithmetic Groups
arxiv-2201-00306.creator: T. N. Venkataramana
arxiv-2201-00306.description: Abstract . We sketch a simplification of proofs of old results on the arithmeticity of the group generated by opposing integral unipotent radicals contained in higher rank arithmetic groups. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary Secondary T. N. Venkataramana, School of Mathematics, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Homi Bhabha Road, Bombay - 400 005, INDIA. venky@math.tifr.res.in 1.

arxiv-2208-09128.title: Totally Nonnegative Tropical Flags and the Totally Nonnegative Flag Dressian
arxiv-2208-09128.creator: Jonathan Boretsky
arxiv-2208-09128.description: Abstract We study the totally nonnegative part of the complete flag variety and of its tropicalization. We show that Lusztig’s notion of nonnegative complete flag variety coincides with the flags in the complete flag variety which have nonnegative Plücker coordinates.

arxiv-2305-02451.title: Ground-to-UAV Integrated Network: Low Latency Communication over Interference Channel
arxiv-2305-02451.creator: Sudhanshu Arya, and Ying Wang
arxiv-2305-02451.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sudhanshu Arya, and Ying Wang. We present a novel and first-of-its-kind information-theoretic framework for the key design consideration and implementation of a ground-to-UAV (G2U) communication network with an aim to minimize end-to-end transmission delay in the presence of interference. The proposed framework is useful as it describes the minimum transmission latency for an uplink ground-to-UAV communication must satisfy while achieving a given level of reliability.

arxiv-2306-02979.title: The Chai Platform’s AI Safety Framework
arxiv-2306-02979.creator: Xiaoding Lu, Aleksey Korshuk, Zongyi Liu, William Beauchamp, Chai Research
arxiv-2306-02979.description: Abstract Chai empowers users to create and interact with customized chatbots, offering unique and engaging experiences. Despite the exciting prospects, the work recognizes the inherent challenges of a commitment to modern safety standards. Therefore, this paper presents the integrated AI safety principles into Chai to prioritize user safety, data protection, and ethical technology use.

arxiv-2312-15666.title: Dynamics of Apparent Horizon and a null comparison principle
arxiv-2312-15666.creator: Xinliang An, Taoran He
arxiv-2312-15666.description: Abstract . This paper investigates the global dynamics of the apparent horizon. We present an approach to establish its existence and its long-term behaviors. Our apparent horizon is constructed by solving the marginally outer trapped surface (MOTS) along each incoming null hypersurface.

arxiv-2403-16666.title: Revisiting the Sleeping Beauty problem
arxiv-2403-16666.creator: Piva P. S, Ruffolo G
arxiv-2403-16666.description: Abstract The Sleeping Beauty problem is a probability riddle with no definite solution for more than two decades and its solution is of great interest in many fields of knowledge. There are two main competing solutions to the problem: the halfer approach, and the thirder approach.

arxiv-2404-19017.title: SN 1054 as a Pulsar-Driven Supernova: Implications for the Crab Pulsar and Remnant Evolution 2024 SN 1054 as a Pulsar-Driven Supernova: Implications for the Crab Pulsar and Remnant Evolution – B
arxiv-2404-19017.creator: Conor M. B. Omand, Nikhil Sarin, Tea Temim
arxiv-2404-19017.description: Abstract One of the most studied objects in astronomy, the Crab Nebula, is the remnant of the historical supernova SN 1054. Historical observations of the supernova imply a typical supernova luminosity, but contemporary observations of the remnant imply a low explosion energy and low ejecta kinetic energy.

arxiv-2504-00977.title: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction: A Survey Thanks: Corresponding author: Jungyeul Park, Email: jungyeul@kaist.ac.kr .
arxiv-2504-00977.creator: Mengyang Qiu †‡ Qingyu Gao ‡ Linxuan Yang § Yang Gu ‡
arxiv-2504-00977.description: Abstract Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is a critical task in natural language processing, addressing the growing demand for automated writing assistance in both second-language (L2) and native-speaker (L1) Chinese writing. While L2 learners face challenges in mastering complex grammatical structures, L1 users also benefit from CGEC in academic, professional, and formal contexts where writing precision is essential.

arxiv-2508-18073.title: Debian in the Research Software Ecosystem: A Bibliometric Analysis
arxiv-2508-18073.creator: Joenio Marques da Costa, Christina von Flach
arxiv-2508-18073.description: Abstract Context : The Debian system has historically participated in academic works and scientific projects, with well-known examples including NeuroDebian, Debian Med, Debsources, Debian Science, and Debian GIS, where the scientific relevance of Debian and its contribution to the Research Software ecosystem are evident.

pmc-11009549.title: Physical performance and body composition reference values for modern US Marine Corps women
pmc-11009549.creator: Adam W Potter, David P Looney, William J Tharion, Lyndsey J Nindl, Angie Pazmino, Lara D Soto, Danielle M Arcidiacono, Karl E Friedl
pmc-11009549.description: Women’s roles in the US military have progressively changed over the past several decades. Previously women were barred from combat roles. Recent change in policy allow women into combat roles in the Marine Corps, and this has led to women being trained for combat specialties.ObjectivesThis observational cross-sectional study describes body composition and performance values for modern Marine Corps women.

pmc-11377206.title: Effects of Broth pH and Chilling Storage on the Changes in Volatile Profiles of Boiled Chicken Flesh
pmc-11377206.creator: Pattarabhorn Pakaweerachat, Teerin Chysirichote
pmc-11377206.description: This study investigated the changes in volatile compounds in chicken flesh after boiling at various pHs (6.0–9.0) and after chilling storage (4.0±1.0°C) for 7 d. The volatile compounds were assessed qualitatively and quantitatively by using a headspace gas chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis. Twenty-one volatile compounds were discovered and categorized as amine, aldehyde, alcohol, ketone, acid, and furan.

pmc-11430286.title: Local Invasion Patterns Characterized by SARIFA and Tumor Budding Differ and Have Distinct Prognostic Significance in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma and Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-11430286.creator: Ákos Jakab, Levente Zarándy, Ildikó Kocsmár, Tibor Várkonyi, István Kenessey, Attila Szijártó, András Kiss, Tamás Vass, Gábor Lotz, Éva Kocsmár
pmc-11430286.description: Simple SummaryTumor budding (TB), poorly differentiated clusters (PDCs), and the Stroma AReactive Invasion Front Area (SARIFA) are emerging biomarkers offering fast and cost-effective ways of assisting the clinical therapeutic decision. However, in esophageal cancers, their applicability has not been fully elucidated.

pmc-11512393.title: Asparagine Availability Is a Critical Limiting Factor for Infectious Spleen and Kidney Necrosis Virus Replication
pmc-11512393.creator: Baofu Ma, Fangying Li, Xiaozhe Fu, Xia Luo, Qiang Lin, Hongru Liang, Yinjie Niu, Ningqiu Li, Jian Zhang, Thomas B Waltzek
pmc-11512393.description: Infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) has brought huge economic loss to the aquaculture industry. Through interfering with the viral replication and proliferation process that depends on host cells, its pathogenicity can be effectively reduced. In this study, we investigated the role of asparagine metabolites in ISKNV proliferation.

pmc-12405638.title: Quercetin boosts gut microbiota-driven production of isovanillic acid to alleviate colitis via enhancing intestinal barrier function
pmc-12405638.creator: Liang Lei, Jing Wang, Juanjuan Wang, Wenjuan He, Tao Wu, Jing Li, Xiaobin Bi, Mei Mei, Xinlei Guan, Xiaoqiang Zhu
pmc-12405638.description: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a severe inflammatory bowel disease marked by intestinal inflammation, compromised barrier function, and gut microbiota imbalance, with a restricted range of therapeutic options currently available. Quercetin, a flavonoid extracted from fruits and vegetables, have been shown significant anti-inflammatory and microbiota-modulating effects. However, the interactions between gut microbes and quercetin in colitis remain insufficiently elucidated.

pmc-12571898.title: Transitions in dynamical regime and neural mode during perceptual decisions
pmc-12571898.creator: Thomas Zhihao Luo, Timothy Doyeon Kim, Diksha Gupta, Adrian G Bondy, Charles D Kopec, Verity A Elliott, Brian DePasquale, Carlos D Brody
pmc-12571898.description: Perceptual decision-making is thought to be mediated by neuronal networks with attractor dynamics1,2. However, the dynamics underlying the complex neuronal responses during decision-making remain unclear. Here we use simultaneous recordings of hundreds of neurons, combined with an unsupervised, deep-learning-based method, to discover decision-related neural dynamics in the rat frontal cortex and striatum as animals accumulate pulsatile auditory evidence.

pmc-12655211.title: Implementation of a Potential Industrial Green, Economical, and Safe Strategy to Enhance Commercial Viability of Liquid Self-Nanoemulsifying Drug Delivery System
pmc-12655211.creator: Abdelrahman Y Sherif, Mohammad A Altamimi, Ehab M Elzayat
pmc-12655211.description: Background/Objectives: Conventional solidification methods for liquid self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery systems face significant limitations. This includes complex manufacturing processes, high costs, and environmental concerns. This study aimed to develop and optimize a thermoresponsive self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery system (T-SNEDDS) for dapagliflozin as a sustainable alternative solidification technique. Methods: Oil and surfactant were selected based on solubility and emulsification studies.

pmc-13017467.title: Characteristics Associated With Disseminated Gonococcal Infections vs Uncomplicated Gonorrhea: A California Case-control Study, 2021–2022
pmc-13017467.creator: Kelly A Johnson, Roshani Fernando, Rosalyn Plotzker, Nicole O Burghardt, Robert E Snyder, Wyatt Hanft, Kurtis Mohr, Lizzete Alvarado, Gwenyth Crise, Eric C Tang, Kathleen Jacobson
pmc-13017467.description: Odds of disseminated versus uncomplicated gonorrhea increased among people not prioritized for routine uncomplicated gonorrhea screening, including men who only had sex with female partners (odds ratio [OR] 10.8; 95% confidence interval [CI], 4.8–24.1), people using substances (OR 10.0; 95% CI, 5.4–18.6), and older people (OR 1.09 per year; 95% CI, 1.07–1.11).
